share_definitions.share_vs_hzb_survivors: software clusters/frame divided by HZB survivors per culling frame (fraction of the hardware-visible candidate stream routed to software)
share_definitions.share_vs_hzb_candidates: software clusters/frame divided by HZB candidates per culling frame (fraction of the post-history-test candidate stream routed to software)

e2.note: a NEGATIVE frame delta means the hybrid frame was faster; the hypothesis predicts a negative correlation between subpixel share and frame delta
